description: Polyperc 1 on channel 1 and Doubledecker on channel 2 play a four-bar song at 90 BPM from three song slots of 16, 32 and 16 steps, in C major. The bass plays degrees 0, 0, 4 and 0 at octave minus 1 on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13, MIDI 48, 48, 55 and 48. The lead plays degrees 4, 2, 4 and 6 on steps 3, 7, 11 and 15 at velocity 60, MIDI 67, 64, 67 and 71. In the one-bar intro the lead channel is muted and the bass plays alone at velocity 70. In the two-bar verse the lead is unmuted. In the final bar the lead moves up an octave, MIDI 79, 76, 79 and 83, and the bass velocity mask drops to 40. Listen for the lead entering after the first bar, about 2.7 seconds in, and for the last bar, about 8 seconds in, sounding higher on top and softer underneath.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
